articles.summary: This month, we added environment governance with a Disable manual IaC sync setting that keeps AI coding agents from altering production infrastructure, while IaC sync keeps working through repository webhooks and CI automation tools. We expanded cost reporting with an Untagged costs page that shows the resources behind Unmanaged spend and generates the commands to tag them, and every cost chart now drills down on click. ECS and Fargate task apps keep their execution history past ECS's one-hour retention, and every Nullstone app module now reports the environment values your app actually received. Read on for details.
articles.title: Changelog: November 2026
